description: MCP server for Bags on Solana: token analytics, trade quotes, and gated write operations.
name: io.github.edycutjong/bagos

environmentVariables.description: Bags API key from dev.bags.fm. Required for all tools.
environmentVariables.name: BAGS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Solana cluster: devnet (default) or mainnet. Writes on mainnet move real funds.
environmentVariables.name: BAGS_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Custom Solana RPC endpoint. Defaults to the public RPC for BAGS_NETWORK.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Path to a Solana keypair JSON file. Only required for write tools.
environmentVariables.name: BAGS_KEYPAIR_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on SOL spent by any single transaction. Default 0.1.
environmentVariables.name: BAGS_MAX_SOL_PER_TX

environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on total SOL spent across one server session. Default 1.0.
environmentVariables.name: BAGS_MAX_SOL_PER_SESSION

environmentVariables.description: Set true to skip the two-step confirmation on writes. Default false.
environmentVariables.name: BAGS_ALLOW_UNCONFIRMED

environmentVariables.description: Mint address of the BOS token used for gating write tools.
environmentVariables.name: BOS_TOKEN_MINT

environmentVariables.description: Minimum BOS balance required to call write tools. Default 10000.
environmentVariables.name: BOS_REQUIRED_BALANCE

environmentVariables.description: Permit non-SOL-input swaps, which the SOL-denominated caps cannot limit.
environmentVariables.name: BAGS_ALLOW_UNCAPPED_TOKEN_SWAPS

title: BagOS
